scripts.title: All checkpoints plus no fall damage VERY overpowered
scripts.features:
Description

Abyss World Script for PC Only:

Features:
1. No Fall Damage - Prevents taking damage from high falls.
2. Fly - Fly freely around the map.
3. Noclip - Walk through walls and obstacles.
4. Low Gravity - Reduces gravity for easier jumps and slower falls.
5. WalkSpeed - Adjust your movement speed.
6. Teleport - Instantly teleport to checkpoints 1–14.
7. Lots of Extra Features - Includes many additional tools and experimental features to explore.
8. No Key System

scripts.title: Slow Fall Teleport to Checkpoints Platform Get Free Wings
scripts.features:
Abyss World Script for PC Only:

Features:
1. Slow Falling - Fall slowly
2. Emergency Platform - Press "Left Ctrl" key to spawn a platform beneath your character to catch your fall. This platform follows the player around. Other Players cannot use your platform.
3. Waypoint - Press "T" key to set your waypoint. Then press "Left Shift" key to teleport at waypoint's position instantly.
4. Teleport - Teleport to each checkpoints instantly. Checkpoints 1 to 14.
5. Spectator Mode - Allows you to move camera freely without your character moving, this allows you to find the correct path to traverse. Press "H" Key to activate and deactivate spectator mode.
6. Get Wings - Allows you to get the Wings cosmetics in the game for free.
7. Teleport to Players - Allows you to teleport to the position of any players in the game. Useful if you have friends in game.
8. Fullbright & Remove Fog - Increases vision to foggy and dark areas.
9. No key system

Disclaimer: This script is originally made by: Maevers. I just added new features into it. Thank you for making this script

local function fireTouchAll()
    local root = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character and game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not firetouchinterest then
        warn("Your exploit does not support firetouchinterest.")
        return
    end

    local function touch(part)
        local partToTouch = part:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart") or part
        if partToTouch then
            task.spawn(function()
                firetouchinterest(partToTouch, root, 1)
                wait(0.1)
                firetouchinterest(partToTouch, root, 0)
            end)
        end
    end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("TouchTransmitter") then
            touch(descendant)
        end
    end
end

local c = w:CreateFolder("Get Wings")

c:Button("Get Wings", function()
    fireTouchAll()
end)
